items.title: First words

translations.en: The first kalima begins with which meaning?
translations.ur: پہلا کلمہ کس معنی سے شروع ہوتا ہے؟

options.text: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah

items.explanation: It teaches tawheed: only Allah is worshipped.
items.explanationUr: یہ توحید سکھاتا ہے: عبادت صرف اللہ کی ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: The messenger

translations.en: Who does the first kalima call the messenger of Allah?
translations.ur: پہلا کلمہ کسے اللہ کا رسول کہتا ہے؟

items.explanation: The testimony names Muhammad as Allah's messenger.
items.explanationUr: گواہی میں محمد کو اللہ کا رسول کہا گیا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: A witness

translations.en: What does "ashhadu" mean?
translations.ur: "اشہد" کا کیا مطلب ہے؟

items.explanation: Ashhadu means I bear witness.
items.explanationUr: اشہد کا مطلب ہے میں گواہی دیتا ہوں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: One Allah

translations.en: The kalimas teach us to worship how many gods?
translations.ur: کلمے کتنے معبودوں کی عبادت سکھاتے ہیں؟

items.explanation: Muslims worship Allah alone.
items.explanationUr: مسلمان صرف اللہ کی عبادت کرتے ہیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: A partner

translations.en: What does "la sharika lah" mean?
translations.ur: "لا شریک لہ" کا مطلب کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: It means Allah has no partner.
items.explanationUr: اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کا کوئی شریک نہیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Praise

translations.en: Where does praise belong in the third kalima?
translations.ur: تیسرے کلمے میں تعریف کس کے لیے ہے؟

items.explanation: Alhamdu lillah means all praise is for Allah.
items.explanationUr: الحمد للہ کا مطلب ہے تمام تعریف اللہ کے لیے ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: The greatest

translations.en: What does "Allahu akbar" mean?
translations.ur: "اللہ اکبر" کا مطلب کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: Akbar here means greater than everything else.
items.explanationUr: اکبر کا مطلب ہے وہ سب سے بڑا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Forgiveness

translations.en: The fifth kalima is mainly about what?
translations.ur: پانچواں کلمہ زیادہ تر کس کے بارے میں ہے؟

items.explanation: Istighfar means asking Allah for forgiveness.
items.explanationUr: استغفار کا مطلب اللہ سے معافی مانگنا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Turning away

translations.en: The sixth kalima says a person turns away from what?
translations.ur: چھٹا کلمہ کس چیز سے بیزاری بتاتا ہے؟

options.text: Disbelief and associating partners with Allah

items.explanation: It rejects kufr and shirk. A teacher should explain those words gently.
items.explanationUr: یہ کفر اور شرک سے بیزاری ہے۔ استاد یہ الفاظ نرمی سے سمجھائیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: How many

translations.en: How many kalimas are in this children's set?
translations.ur: بچوں کے اس سیٹ میں کتنے کلمے ہیں؟

items.explanation: This textbook set has six kalimas. That count is a school set, not a verse.
items.explanationUr: یہ نصابی سیٹ چھ کلمے ہیں۔ یہ تعداد کسی آیت کا نمبر نہیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Greeting

translations.en: What do Muslims say when they meet?
translations.ur: ملتے وقت مسلمان کیا کہتے ہیں؟

items.explanation: Salam is a prayer for peace.
items.explanationUr: سلام امن کی دعا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Reply

translations.en: If someone gives you salam, what should you do?
translations.ur: اگر کوئی سلام کہے تو کیا کرنا چاہیے؟

items.explanation: A greeting should be answered. See Quran 4:86 and confirm the verse before approval.
items.explanationUr: سلام کا جواب دینا چاہیے۔ سورۃ النساء 86 دیکھ کر تصدیق کریں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Truth

translations.en: Which choice is honest?
translations.ur: سچ کون سا کام ہے؟

options.text: Hiding a broken cup with a lie
Making up a story to win

items.explanation: Honesty is saying what is true.
items.explanationUr: ایمانداری سچ کہنا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Parents

translations.en: How should a child speak to parents?
translations.ur: بچے کو ماں باپ سے کیسی بات کرنی چاہیے؟

items.explanation: Quran 17:23 tells us not to say "uff" to parents and to speak kindly. The Arabic was fetched for the lessons file.
items.explanationUr: سورۃ الاسراء 23 میں ماں باپ کو اف نہ کہنے اور اچھی بات کرنے کا حکم ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Sharing

translations.en: Your friend has no crayon. What is kind?
translations.ur: دوست کے پاس کریون نہیں۔ مہربانی کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: Sharing is a basic good manner.
items.explanationUr: بانٹنا ایک اچھا ادب ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Names

translations.en: What should we avoid calling a friend?
translations.ur: دوست کو کیا نہیں کہنا چاہیے؟

items.explanation: Name-calling hurts. Allah forbids mocking people in Quran 49:11. Confirm that verse.
items.explanationUr: برے نام دکھ دیتے ہیں۔ سورۃ الحجرات 11 میں مذاق سے منع ہے۔ تصدیق کریں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Listening

translations.en: When a parent is speaking, a kind child does what?
translations.ur: جب والدین بول رہے ہوں تو مہربان بچہ کیا کرتا ہے؟

items.explanation: Listening is part of respect.
items.explanationUr: سننا عزت کا حصہ ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Sorry

translations.en: If you bump someone, what do you say?
translations.ur: اگر کسی سے ٹکرا جاؤ تو کیا کہو؟

items.explanation: A small apology keeps peace.
items.explanationUr: معافی سلامتی رکھتی ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Mosque voice

translations.en: Inside the mosque, which voice is better?
translations.ur: مسجد میں کون سی آواز بہتر ہے؟

items.explanation: The mosque is a place for prayer and calm.
items.explanationUr: مسجد نماز اور سکون کی جگہ ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Clean hands

translations.en: Before eating, what should you do?
translations.ur: کھانے سے پہلے کیا کرنا چاہیے؟

items.explanation: Clean hands are a health and cleanliness lesson.
items.explanationUr: صاف ہاتھ صفائی کا سبق ہیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Thanks

translations.en: When someone helps you, what do you say?
translations.ur: جب کوئی مدد کرے تو کیا کہتے ہو؟

items.explanation: Gratitude is for people and, more deeply, for Allah.
items.explanationUr: شکر لوگوں کا بھی ہے اور اصل میں اللہ کا بھی۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Animals

translations.en: How should we treat a cat or a bird?
translations.ur: بلی یا پرندے کے ساتھ کیسا برتاؤ کریں؟

items.explanation: Kindness to animals is part of good character. A reviewer can add a checked hadith.
items.explanationUr: جانوروں پر مہربانی اچھے اخلاق میں ہے
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Queue

translations.en: At a water tap, what is fair?
translations.ur: پانی کے نل پر انصاف کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: Taking turns is fairness.
items.explanationUr: باری لینا انصاف ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Secrets

translations.en: A friend tells you a kind secret. What do you do?
translations.ur: دوست کوئی اچھی بات راز میں کہے۔ کیا کرو گے؟

items.explanation: Trust is part of honesty. Do not keep a secret that hides someone being hurt; tell a parent.
items.explanationUr: اعتماد ایمانداری کا حصہ ہے۔ اگر کسی کو نقصان ہو رہا ہو تو راز نہ رکھیں، والدین کو بتائیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Guests

translations.en: A guest comes to your home. What is kind?
translations.ur: مہمان گھر آئے۔ مہربانی کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: Honoring a guest is a Muslim manner. Confirm any hadith before quoting one.
items.explanationUr: مہمان کی عزت مسلمانوں کا ادب ہے۔ حدیث نقل کرنے سے پہلے اسے چیک کریں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: How many

translations.en: How many obligatory prayers are there in a day?
translations.ur: دن میں کتنی فرض نمازیں ہیں؟

items.explanation: Muslims pray five obligatory prayers each day.
items.explanationUr: مسلمان دن میں پانچ فرض نمازیں پڑھتے ہیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Dawn

translations.en: Which prayer comes at dawn?
translations.ur: فجر کے وقت کون سی نماز ہے؟

items.explanation: Fajr is the dawn prayer.
items.explanationUr: فجر صبح کی نماز ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Noon

translations.en: Which prayer comes after the sun passes midday?
translations.ur: دوپہر کے بعد کون سی نماز ہے؟

items.explanation: Zuhr is the midday prayer.
items.explanationUr: ظہر دوپہر کی نماز ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Afternoon

translations.en: Which prayer comes in the late afternoon?
translations.ur: دن کے آخری حصے میں کون سی نماز ہے؟

items.explanation: Asr is the afternoon prayer.
items.explanationUr: عصر دوپہر کے بعد کی نماز ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Sunset

translations.en: Which prayer comes just after sunset?
translations.ur: غروبِ آفتاب کے بعد کون سی نماز ہے؟

items.explanation: Maghrib is the sunset prayer.
items.explanationUr: مغرب غروب کی نماز ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Night

translations.en: Which prayer comes at night?
translations.ur: رات کو کون سی نماز ہے؟

items.explanation: Isha is the night prayer.
items.explanationUr: عشاء رات کی نماز ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Direction

translations.en: Which way do Muslims face for salah?
translations.ur: نماز میں مسلمان کس طرف رخ کرتے ہیں؟

items.explanation: The qibla is the direction of the Kaaba.
items.explanationUr: قبلہ خانہ کعبہ کی سمت ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Ready

translations.en: What should we make before salah when water is available?
translations.ur: پانی ہو تو نماز سے پہلے کیا کریں؟

items.explanation: Wudu is the washing taught before prayer. Quran 5:6 names the main washes.
items.explanationUr: وضو نماز سے پہلے کی صفائی ہے۔ سورۃ المائدہ 6 میں اصل دھونے کا ذکر ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Face

translations.en: In the wudu verse, what is washed first among these?
translations.ur: وضو کی آیت میں ان میں سے پہلے کیا دھویا جاتا ہے؟

items.explanation: Quran 5:6 says to wash the faces. The fetched Arabic is in the lessons file.
items.explanationUr: سورۃ المائدہ 6 میں منہ دھونے کا ذکر ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Arms

translations.en: How far are the arms washed in that verse?
translations.ur: اس آیت میں ہاتھ کہاں تک دھوئے جاتے ہیں؟

items.explanation: Quran 5:6 says to the elbows.
items.explanationUr: سورۃ المائدہ 6 میں کہنیوں تک کا ذکر ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Head

translations.en: What does the wudu verse say about the head?
translations.ur: وضو کی آیت سر کے بارے میں کیا کہتی ہے؟

items.explanation: The verse says to wipe over your heads.
items.explanationUr: آیت میں سر کا مسح کرنے کو کہا گیا ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Feet

translations.en: In that verse, the feet are washed to where?
translations.ur: اس آیت میں پاؤں کہاں تک دھوئے جاتے ہیں؟

items.explanation: Quran 5:6 says to the ankles. Families may teach extra sunnah steps; ask a parent.
items.explanationUr: سورۃ المائدہ 6 میں ٹخنوں تک کا ذکر ہے۔ اضافی سنتیں والدین سے پوچھیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Calm

translations.en: During salah, which body is better?
translations.ur: نماز میں کون سا بدن بہتر ہے؟

items.explanation: Salah is quiet worship.
items.explanationUr: نماز خاموش عبادت ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Rows

translations.en: In a group prayer, children should do what?
translations.ur: جماعت میں بچوں کو کیا کرنا چاہیے؟

items.explanation: The row is straight and calm.
items.explanationUr: صف سیدھی اور پُرسکون ہوتی ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Learning

translations.en: If you do not know the words yet, what is right?
translations.ur: اگر الفاظ ابھی نہ آئیں تو کیا ٹھیک ہے؟

options.text: Pray beside a parent and keep learning

items.explanation: A child learns with a parent. We do not invent Quranic words.
items.explanationUr: بچہ والدین کے ساتھ سیکھتا ہے۔ قرآنی الفاظ خود نہیں بناتے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Pillars

translations.en: How many pillars of Islam are in the famous hadith?
translations.ur: مشہور حدیث میں اسلام کے کتنے ستون ہیں؟

items.explanation: The hadith "Islam is built upon five" is in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. Confirm the number in your edition.
items.explanationUr: حدیث "اسلام کی بنیاد پانچ پر ہے" بخاری اور مسلم میں ہے۔ اپنے نسخے میں نمبر دیکھیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: First pillar

translations.en: Which pillar is the testimony of faith?
translations.ur: کون سا ستون کلمۂ شہادت ہے؟

items.explanation: The shahada is the first of the five.
items.explanationUr: شہادت پانچ میں پہلا ستون ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Fast

translations.en: In which month do Muslims fast?
translations.ur: مسلمان کس مہینے کے روزے رکھتے ہیں؟

options.text: Every Monday of the year as a pillar

items.explanation: Fasting in Ramadan is a pillar. Quran 2:185 names Ramadan. Confirm the verse.
items.explanationUr: رمضان کے روزے ستون ہیں۔ سورۃ البقرہ 185 میں رمضان کا ذکر ہے۔ تصدیق کریں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Charity

translations.en: What is zakat?
translations.ur: زکوٰۃ کیا ہے؟

options.text: Obligatory charity for those who must pay it

items.explanation: Zakat is a pillar. The details of who pays it are for a parent or teacher.
items.explanationUr: زکوٰۃ ایک ستون ہے۔ کس پر فرض ہے، یہ والدین یا استاد بتائیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Journey

translations.en: Hajj is a journey to which city?
translations.ur: حج کس شہر کا سفر ہے؟

items.explanation: Hajj is to Makkah, once in a lifetime for the person who is able.
items.explanationUr: حج مکہ کا سفر ہے، جو شخص قادر ہو اس پر زندگی میں ایک بار۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Book

translations.en: What is the holy book of Islam?
translations.ur: اسلام کی مقدس کتاب کیا ہے؟

items.explanation: The Quran is Allah's revealed book.
items.explanationUr: قرآن اللہ کی اتاری ہوئی کتاب ہے۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Prophet

translations.en: Who received the Quran?
translations.ur: قرآن کس پر اترا؟

items.explanation: Allah revealed the Quran to Muhammad through Jibril.
items.explanationUr: اللہ نے قرآن محمد پر جبریل کے ذریعے اتارا۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Angel

translations.en: Which angel brought the revelation?
translations.ur: وحی کون سا فرشتہ لایا؟

items.explanation: Jibril is the angel of revelation. Confirm the child-friendly wording.
items.explanationUr: جبریل وحی کے فرشتے ہیں۔ بچوں کے لیے الفاظ کی تصدیق کریں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Makkah

translations.en: In which city was Prophet Muhammad born?
translations.ur: نبی محمد کس شہر میں پیدا ہوئے؟

items.explanation: He was born in Makkah. This is standard seerah; a reviewer should name the book they trust.
items.explanationUr: آپ مکہ میں پیدا ہوئے۔ یہ سیرت کی مشہور بات ہے؛ معتبر کتاب کا نام لکھیں۔
items.source: Basic Islamic teaching for children. A reviewer should attach the exact Quran or hadith reference before this is called verified.

items.title: Madinah

translations.en: To which city did the Prophet move in the Hijrah?
translations.ur: ہجرت میں نبی کس شہر گئے؟
